newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies 14 issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies 14 issues for bond insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 14 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Sandwich, Mass., $3.46 million general obligation muni purpose loan.
--Canton Charter Township, Mich., $2.14 million special assessment bonds.
--Pinckney Community Schools, Mich., $73 million school building bonds.
--Roswell Independent School District, N.M., $5 million school building bonds.
--Jasper Troupsberg SD, N.Y., $3.875 million school district bonds.
--Poughkeepsie Town, N.Y., $1.7 million public improvement bonds.
--Bryan, Texas, $3.250 million tax and revenue improvement bonds.
--Clark County, Nevada, $13 million and $287 million school district bonds.
